svg.title: Sustained decode speed at 64K context
svg.desc: Bar chart of sustained decode speed on iPhone 17 Pro at 64K context: Rewrite 84.3 tok/s, Chat 57.8 tok/s, Document Q&A 56.9 tok/s, and Think 51.9 tok/s — each well above upstream v0.18.0's 27 tok/s at 32K.

text.font-family: ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: iPhone 17 Pro (Release, tok/s, higher is faster)
